## Professional focus
- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
- Full-stack web development with React, Node.js, Express, and databases
- Cybersecurity and ethical security testing
- Digital forensics and image metadata analysis
- Python development, scripting, and automation

## Selected projects
- [ScamSentry AI](https://github.com/coderujwal3/ScamSentry-AI) — **AI + Security · Hackday build.** A Python CLI that inspects suspicious text and URLs using deterministic signals, explains social-engineering indicators, validates AI interpretations, and assigns an explainable risk band.
- [Image-Forensic](https://github.com/coderujwal3/Image-Forensic) — **Digital Forensics · Open source.** A Python library focused on JPEG parsing and EXIF metadata extraction, with a clean API and forensic-minded reporting about what metadata can—and cannot—prove.
- [Phoenix Shell](https://github.com/hackedarea/phoenix-shell) — **Developer Tools · Project.** A terminal-first shell project exploring command-line workflows and developer productivity.
- [Dhoomchhalle](https://github.com/coderujwal3/Dhoomchhalle) — **Full-stack · Travel · In progress.** A traveler-focused platform concept to make local travel less confusing, bringing hotel discovery and useful destination information into one experience.
- [SAMWAAD](https://github.com/coderujwal3/samwaad) — **Full-stack · College club project.** A web application for a college club that facilitates event management, member engagement, and communication, built using the MERN stack.
- [Attendance Management System using Face Recognition](https://github.com/coderujwal3/Attendance_Management_System_Using_Face_Recognition) — **Artificial Intelligence · ML experiments.** A Python application that automates student attendance tracking using face recognition, OpenCV, and a Tkinter interface.
